## Featured Engineering & Quantitative Projects
### 1. Market Sentiment Analyzer & Backtesting Engine
- Category: Quantitative Finance
- Stack: Python, Pandas, NumPy, yFinance, Matplotlib
- Core Logic: Vectorized 20-day / 50-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) crossover rule tested on historical data for INFY and TATAINVEST.
- Methodology: Positions are shifted by 1 day [position.shift(1)] to simulate next-day execution and eliminate look-ahead bias.
- Results:
  - INFY Buy-and-Hold: Max Drawdown -36.4%, Volatility 24.1%, Sharpe 0.32.
  - INFY 20/50 SMA: Max Drawdown -18.2%, Volatility 15.3%, Sharpe 0.35.
  - TATAINVEST Buy-and-Hold: Max Drawdown -52.1%, Volatility 31.8%, Sharpe 0.51.
  - TATAINVEST 20/50 SMA: Max Drawdown -24.8%, Volatility 19.7%, Sharpe 0.60.
- Repository: https://github.com/rakshitjainai/market-sentiment-analyzer

### 2. LawPrix — Transparent Legal Services Matchmaking
- Category: LegalTech / Product Management
- Stack: React.js, Python, REST APIs, CSS3
- Distinction: 2nd Runner-Up at the national Tutedude Buildathon 2025
- Solution: Replaced sponsor-bidding directories with an objective, criteria-driven intake system categorized across 4 legal domains (corporate, criminal, family, property), verifying Bar Council registration and providing milestone progress tracking.
- Live Application: https://lawprix.com/

### 3. RegMate — Regulatory Compliance Workflow
- Category: RegTech / Financial Technology
- Stack: Python, Streamlit, Pandas
- Solution: Automated validation tool that cross-checks corporate onboarding documentation against IFSCA and DGFT statutory checklists, flagging missing identifiers before regulatory submission.

### 4. Custom Unix Shell in C
- Category: Systems Programming
- Stack: C, POSIX APIs, Linux
- Solution: Implemented a custom Unix command shell supporting command execution via `fork()` and `execvp()`, input/output file redirection (`<`, `>`), and multi-command piping (`|`).

## Research Papers & Publications
1. **Understanding India's Bullion Market: The Role of IIBX and GIFT City**
   - Author: Rakshit Jain (Published July 2026)
   - Read Time: 9 min read
   - Abstract: Examines India's transition from fragmented OTC gold consignment imports to a centralized international exchange at GIFT City. Details the mechanics of Bullion Depository Receipts (BDRs), Qualified Jeweller (QJ) access criteria, and institutional KYC/GST/IEC compliance under IFSCA regulations.
2. **Understanding a 20/50 SMA Crossover: Building and Evaluating a Simple Trading Strategy**
   - Author: Rakshit Jain (Published March 2026)
   - Read Time: 11 min read
   - Abstract: Walkthrough of a Python backtesting engine evaluating a 20/50 daily SMA crossover on NSE equities. Analyzes geometric CAGR, annualized Sharpe ratio against India's 91-day T-Bill rate, and the risk mitigation achieved by cutting maximum drawdown in half.
3. **From Financial Workflows to FinTech Products: Where Technology Can Make a Difference**
   - Author: Rakshit Jain (Published August 2026)
   - Read Time: 10 min read
   - Abstract: Discusses the "Interface Gap" in institutional finance, where microsecond trading engines are paired with manual document reconciliation. Maps product engineering opportunities in multi-authority identifier reconciliation (PAN, GST, IEC) and audit-ready workflow automation.
